# Vintage Fashion

> Vintage Fashion is an authentic curated online store for premium vintage fashion, menswear, overshirts, jackets, denim, and streetwear.

## Store Navigation & Key Pages
- [Home](https://vintage-fashion-xi.vercel.app/): Main storefront with featured seasonal drops and curated collections.
- [Shop All Products](https://vintage-fashion-xi.vercel.app/shop): Full product catalog with size, price, and category filters.
- [Curated Collections](https://vintage-fashion-xi.vercel.app/collection): Hand-picked archive fashion edits.
- [About Us](https://vintage-fashion-xi.vercel.app/about): Our heritage and sustainable fashion curation philosophy.
- [Customer Contact](https://vintage-fashion-xi.vercel.app/contact): Support details and store location.
- [Size Guide](https://vintage-fashion-xi.vercel.app/size-guide): Sizing charts and measuring instructions for vintage apparel.
- [Returns Policy](https://vintage-fashion-xi.vercel.app/returns): 7-day doorstep return and refund policy.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://vintage-fashion-xi.vercel.app/faq): Orders, shipping timelines, and payment FAQs.
